answer: Identity without cost is inventory. Burn a non-refundable 500-unit deposit per registration; bulk cloning is pure loss. A zenith of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the signal of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and mesa-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
